title: A Primer of Iron Qi
summary: Teaches a new Warrior to lay metal qi over the hand and forearm so the open palm and the fist strike with the hardness of iron.

title: First Lessons in Steel Skin
summary: A set of first exercises that draw metal qi into the skin until it turns a glancing cut, with one small lesson in closing a shallow wound.

title: The Needle Throwing Primer
summary: A primer on casting slender needles of hardened qi, and on feeling a needle's flight and return through the metal affinity.

title: Copper Wire Drills
summary: Drills in spinning a thread of metal qi into a wire that lashes, loops, tugs and wraps.

title: Lodestone Pull Lessons
summary: Lessons in the pull the metal affinity has on iron: drawing a loose blade, clinging to a surface, and feeling metal at a distance.

title: The Edge Honing Course
summary: A course in lending keenness and weight to a blade through metal qi, for the Warrior's own weapon or a companion's.

title: Handbook of the Coin Flick
summary: A handbook for throwing a small flat piece of metal with qi so it flies true, spins keen and can be called back to the hand.

title: The Rivet and Nail Primer
summary: A primer on driving, throwing and fixing nails and rivets of metal qi to pierce, pin and hold fast.

title: Bell Tone Exercises
summary: Exercises in setting metal qi ringing like a struck bell, to shake a foe, shield the body and read the tone of nearby metal.

title: The Plate Grower's Lessons
summary: Lessons in growing plates and scales of metal from the qi in the air around the body, then using them to guard and to cut.
